intended_purpose: A reusable, non-invasive manual instrument intended for use by clinicians to elicit and assess deep tendon reflexes during routine neurological examination.
device_description: Handheld reusable reflex hammer with a weighted rubber head and telescopic handle, non-sterile, reusable after standard surface disinfection. Class I device under EU MDR Annex VIII Rule 1 (non-invasive, reusable surgical/examination instrument).
clinical_data_summary: No clinical trial was performed or required; equivalence to long-established manual reflex hammers already in routine clinical use is claimed based on identical mechanical design and intended use, consistent with the general safety and performance requirements for this device type.
risk_summary: Risk management file per ISO 14971 identifies 5 hazards, primarily related to material biocompatibility and cross-contamination between patients. All residual risks rated acceptable after mitigation (biocompatible materials, disinfection instructions in the IFU).

clinical_trial_data.trial_name: Usability study, n=6 (first-time-user comprehension of the instructions for use)
